intro: My research examines how illicit economic activity, public institutions, governance, and fiscal choices relate to development and macroeconomic outcomes.

themes.title: Money laundering, corruption, and the informal economy
themes.description: Several projects study the economic determinants and consequences of money laundering, with particular attention to corruption, informal economic activity, and socioeconomic development.

themes.title: Public economics and tax administration
themes.description: A research project develops a conceptual model for identifying factors associated with taxpayer satisfaction with tax administration, using business taxpayers in Semnan as the case context.

themes.title: Governance and development
themes.description: Related work considers good governance and tourism development, including countries located along the Silk Road.

themes.title: Fiscal policy and external balances
themes.description: Another project examines corruption, government expenditure, and the current-account balance using evidence from the MENA region.

thesis.title: The Effect of Money Laundering on Socioeconomic Development
thesis.title_fa: اثر پولشویی بر توسعه اقتصادی اجتماعی
thesis.note: The thesis is the foundation for the subsequent publication stream on money laundering and development.
